blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Four solar-powered irrigation projects in Leyte and Samar were formally launched on Saturday, Nov. 21, by the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) Region 8 to provide farmers with a more reliable water supply and help them cope with the possible effects of El Niño. The projects, located in Inopacan and San Miguel in Leyte and Jiabong in Samar, will serve a combined 54.99 hectares of farmland and benefit 110 farmers, particularly those in areas at the tail end of irrigation systems where water supply is often inadequate.
